old_p2: Selenite Grey Metallic over AMG Sienna Brown and Black leather is a color combination that commands attention in person. The warm brown against the grey exterior reads as sophisticated rather than sporty, and it is not a pairing most buyers find sitting on a CPO lot. This C 300 was built to a $63,915 MSRP, and the equipment list reflects it. The AMG Line Package at $3,050 adds an AMG-specific front apron, sculpted side sills, and AMG rear apron with diffuser, giving the sedan a visual presence the standard C 300 does not carry. The Pinnacle Line Package at $4,100 represents the top trim level for the C 300 and adds the most refined interior and exterior appointments Mercedes-Benz offers on this platform. The Driver Assistance Package at $1,950 bundles Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC with Active Steering Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Active Lane Change Assist, Evasive Manoeuvre Support, and Route-Based Speed Action. DISTRONIC with Active Steering Assist maintains following distance and actively steers within the lane at highway speeds, handling the mental load of cruise-controlled driving more completely than standard adaptive cruise alone. The Night Package adds blacked-out exterior brightwork and trim, sharpening the AMG visual theme further. Additional equipment includes Burmester Surround Sound System, Panorama Sunroof, Head-Up Display, Surround View Camera, DIGITAL LIGHT with projection function, Augmented Video for Navigation, MBUX Navigation Premium, Heat and Noise-Insulating Acoustic Glass, Sport Seats, Sport Suspension, Multifunction Sport Steering Wheel, AMG Floor Mats, Heated Steering Wheel, Illuminated Door Sills, Natural Grain Black Wood with Aluminum Lines trim, Rear Spoiler in body color, Diamond Grille, and an integrated dashcam. Original MSRP was $63,915. At $41,774, this represents $22,141 in depreciation the next buyer does not absorb. Current asking price is $41,774 (includes $899 dealer administrative fee), $4,376 below J.
